housing: Jacksonville renters mostly live in apartment complexes and rented single-family homes spread across a large city.
climate: Test the air conditioning, look for mold and leaks, and note any storm shutters; summers are hot and hurricanes are possible.
fact: Jacksonville is one of the largest US cities by land area, so rentals range from beach condos to suburban houses.
